title: NuGet Package
description: A NuGet package with its metadata, versions, dependencies, deprecation status, and vulnerability information as represented across the NuGet V3 API.

id.description: The unique identifier of the NuGet package.

version.description: The full SemVer 2.0.0 version string of the package. May contain build metadata.

title.description: The display title of the package.

description.description: A description of the package and its functionality.

summary.description: A short summary of the package.

authors.description: The author or authors of the package.

owners.description: The owner or owners of the package on the package source.

tags.description: Tags associated with the package for categorization and discovery.

language.description: The language of the package content.

iconUrl.description: The URL to the package icon image.

licenseUrl.description: The URL to the package license.

licenseExpression.description: A NuGet license expression compliant with NuGet license expression syntax.

projectUrl.description: The URL to the project home page.

readmeUrl.description: A URL for the rendered HTML view of the package README.

registration.description: The absolute URL to the registration index for this package.

packageContent.description: The URL to the .nupkg file for the latest version.

listed.description: Whether the package is listed and visible in search results. Assumed true if absent.

published.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp of when the package was published. Set to year 1900 on nuget.org when unlisted.

created.description: A timestamp of when the package was first created on the source.

verified.description: Whether the package is verified via ID prefix reservation on nuget.org.

totalDownloads.description: The total number of downloads across all versions.

requireLicenseAcceptance.description: Whether the package requires the user to accept a license before installation.

minClientVersion.description: The minimum NuGet client version required to use this package.

isPrerelease.description: Whether the package version is a prerelease version.

packageHash.description: The hash of the package encoded in standard base 64.

packageHashAlgorithm.description: The hashing algorithm used to produce the packageHash. Typically SHA512.

packageSize.description: The size of the .nupkg file in bytes.

versions.description: All available versions of the package.

dependencyGroups.description: The dependencies of the package grouped by target framework.

packageTypes.description: The package types defined by the package author.

vulnerabilities.description: Security vulnerabilities associated with this package version.

PackageVersion.description: A specific version of a package with its download count and registration leaf URL.

@id.description: The absolute URL to the registration leaf for this version.

downloads.description: The number of downloads for this specific version.

DependencyGroup.description: A group of package dependencies applicable to a specific target framework.

targetFramework.description: The target framework moniker. If absent, the group applies to all frameworks.

dependencies.description: The list of package dependencies in this group.

PackageDependency.description: A dependency on another NuGet package.

id.description: The package ID of the dependency.

range.description: The allowed version range for the dependency. Defaults to any version if absent.

registration.description: The URL to the registration index for this dependency.

PackageType.description: A package type defined by the package author, such as Dependency or DotnetTool.

name.description: The name of the package type.

version.description: The version of the package type. Only present if explicitly specified.

Deprecation.description: Deprecation information indicating a package should no longer be used.

AlternatePackage.description: A recommended replacement package for a deprecated package.

id.description: The ID of the alternate package.

range.description: The allowed version range, or * if any version is acceptable.

Vulnerability.description: A security vulnerability associated with a package version.

advisoryUrl.description: The URL to the security advisory for this vulnerability.

severity.description: The severity level: 0 = Low, 1 = Moderate, 2 = High, 3 = Critical.
